title: Pico Arcade
reason: Needs the offline Arcade collection and cartridge-loading support.
workaround: Install the Arcade collection with the Pocket Sync plugin.
evidence: 2026-10-20 host probe: all 35 selections reach load() and remain in the launcher after an ignored Lua compiler error.

title: Trail of the Sorcerer
reason: Gameplay needs the offline Sorcerer companion collection.
workaround: Install the Sorcerer collection with the Pocket Sync plugin.
evidence: 2026-10-10 supplied-cart report and session probe: rungame() calls load("#mot_sorcerergame"); the companion is absent and the intro never hands off.

title: Pico Backrooms
reason: Crashes during gameplay: this revision calls unsupported rrectfill().
workaround: Use a compatible revision when available; rounded-rectangle support is tracked.
evidence: 2026-10-20 current host replay reproduces the older native/RV32 failure at frame 122, cart.p8:554: rrectfill is nil.

title: Peral
reason: Needs #peral_game and launch parameters larger than the current 255-byte limit.
workaround: This launcher is outside the initial offline collection. Use another cartridge.
evidence: 2026-10-20 current host 600-frame seed-7 smoke fails at frame 234, cart.p8:121. launch_game loads #peral_game with get_translations(); a direct eval measures 730 parameter bytes.

title: Pico Night Funkin
reason: Needs #fnf_select and further game carts outside the initial offline collection.
workaround: Use another cartridge until the full companion collection is supported.
evidence: 2026-10-20 current host 600-frame seed-7 smoke reaches load("#fnf_select") at cart.p8:49; the curated Arcade/Sorcerer bundle has no such target.
